rules.scope: registered English chart tokens and aliases
rules.rationale: Compact and synonymous chart tokens must remain explicit downstream evidence.
rules.failure_condition: Token is not in the registered vocabulary or collides with a schema term.
rules.conflict_policy: Preserve the original token and record the canonical alternative; never delete the source span.

rules.scope: registered task, temporal, aggregation, ranking and channel phrases
rules.rationale: Planning stages require explicit operation hints rather than a single keyword-to-chart decision.
rules.failure_condition: Phrase is outside the versioned vocabulary.
rules.conflict_policy: Retain all detected compatible hints; conflicting hints become explicit evidence, not priority overwrite.

rules.scope: Unicode, case and whitespace normalization
rules.rationale: Equivalent surface forms need stable matching while original evidence remains recoverable.
rules.failure_condition: Input is empty or not a string.
rules.conflict_policy: Original text and per-token spans are authoritative.

rules.scope: bounded common English inflections
rules.rationale: Singular/plural and common inflections should share lexical evidence without rewriting intent.
rules.failure_condition: Suffix rule would create a token shorter than three characters or is not allow-listed.
rules.conflict_policy: Lemmas are auxiliary; normalized query keeps the observed token.

rules.scope: registered comparative, superlative, top and bottom expressions
rules.rationale: Ranking and extremum intent depends on degree and limit evidence.
rules.failure_condition: Comparative expression is outside the registered vocabulary.
rules.conflict_policy: Opposing directions are both retained and later marked ambiguous.

rules.scope: registered negation and limitation tokens
rules.rationale: Filters and exclusions lose meaning if negation is removed.
rules.failure_condition: Token is outside the registered vocabulary.
rules.conflict_policy: Never drop negation; attach it only to an explicit filter during decomposition.

rules.scope: single-table physical and semantic field typing
rules.rationale: Physical dtype and visualization semantic type are distinct facts.
rules.failure_condition: Field has no non-null values and no reliable physical type evidence.
rules.conflict_policy: Retain physical dtype and emit semantic unknown when evidence conflicts.

rules.scope: bounded low-cardinality value anchors under the configured access policy
rules.rationale: Observed values may ground query mentions to fields.
rules.failure_condition: Value matching is disabled, cardinality exceeds the bound, or samples are unavailable.
rules.conflict_policy: Colliding values remain candidates for every matching field.

rules.scope: cardinality, null rate and value distribution profiling
rules.rationale: Role compatibility cannot be inferred from column name alone.
rules.failure_condition: Data values are unavailable.
rules.conflict_policy: Profile missing statistics explicitly; do not invent defaults.

rules.scope: datetime dtype or date-like value evidence
rules.rationale: Temporal roles require value/dtype evidence and should not rely only on field names.
rules.failure_condition: Date parse evidence is weak or based only on a name token.
rules.conflict_policy: Weak name evidence produces a warning or unknown; dtype/value evidence controls the decision.

rules.scope: identifier, ordinal and geographic classification with multiple evidence signals
rules.rationale: Special semantic types need value-distribution evidence in addition to names.
rules.failure_condition: Only a name hint is present or evidence families disagree.
rules.conflict_policy: Prefer unknown/categorical and record a warning rather than force a special type.

rules.scope: explicit normalized field-name mentions
rules.rationale: Explicit fields must not be replaced by schema-order defaults.
rules.failure_condition: No complete field-name span occurs in the query.
rules.conflict_policy: All exact collisions remain candidates.

rules.scope: versioned aliases supplied with the dataset
rules.rationale: User language may use a documented alternate field name.
rules.failure_condition: Alias metadata is absent or the alias does not occur.
rules.conflict_policy: Exact field names outrank aliases; alias collisions remain ambiguous.

rules.scope: exact casefolded matches to bounded profiled values
rules.rationale: A value mention can identify the field that supplies a filter or grouping dimension.
rules.failure_condition: Value index is gated, missing or collides across fields.
rules.conflict_policy: Every colliding field is retained with an ambiguity record.

rules.scope: all M2 field resolution
rules.rationale: Schema linking must be independent from chart construction.
rules.failure_condition: A downstream chart hint is used as field evidence.
rules.conflict_policy: Reject unregistered field evidence and never inject schema-order defaults.

rules.scope: singular/plural and normalized lexical field forms
rules.rationale: Normalized field phrases should match common inflections.
rules.failure_condition: Normalized token sets have no complete or near-complete correspondence.
rules.conflict_policy: Exact lexical evidence outranks normalized evidence.

rules.scope: multi-token fields with non-trivial token overlap
rules.rationale: Natural language may omit modifiers from a column label.
rules.failure_condition: Only generic tokens overlap or overlap is below the configured threshold.
rules.conflict_policy: Token overlap cannot displace exact/alias evidence; ties remain candidates.

rules.scope: already evidenced field candidates
rules.rationale: Semantic type provides a small compatibility signal, not permission to invent a field.
rules.failure_condition: Candidate has no lexical, alias or value evidence.
rules.conflict_policy: Type compatibility cannot create a candidate on its own.

rules.scope: already evidenced candidates with explicit task or operation hints
rules.rationale: Task roles may rank fields while preserving the underlying evidence.
rules.failure_condition: No task/operation evidence or no base field evidence.
rules.conflict_policy: Task-role score is a small component and cannot override exact conflicts.

rules.scope: queries with multiple independently evidenced fields
rules.rationale: Required-field recovery must preserve every named field and expose real multi-field candidates.
rules.failure_condition: A mention has no candidate above threshold.
rules.conflict_policy: Do not collapse different mentions into one field; unresolved mentions are explicit.

rules.scope: declared SkillVIS v2 analytical task vocabulary
rules.rationale: Task candidates require operational semantics separate from chart type.
rules.failure_condition: Intent is outside the declared task vocabulary.
rules.conflict_policy: Compatible primary and secondary tasks coexist.

rules.scope: temporal expression plus temporal and measure field evidence
rules.rationale: Trend requires combined query and schema evidence.
rules.failure_condition: Temporal expression, temporal field or measure evidence is absent.
rules.conflict_policy: Explicit incompatible task remains a separate candidate.

rules.scope: underspecified one- or multi-field requests
rules.rationale: Insufficient evidence should produce alternatives or unresolved state, not a forced default.
rules.failure_condition: Explicit task evidence resolves the interpretation.
rules.conflict_policy: Retain tied plausible tasks and mark task ambiguity.

rules.scope: registered explicit analytical task phrases
rules.rationale: Explicit task language is direct evidence but must not directly choose a chart.
rules.failure_condition: No registered task phrase occurs.
rules.conflict_policy: Multiple explicit task phrases become multiple scored candidates.

rules.scope: ranking, extremum and top/bottom expressions
rules.rationale: Superlatives imply ranking direction and often a bounded extremum result.
rules.failure_condition: Degree/direction evidence is absent.
rules.conflict_policy: Opposing directions produce ambiguity; do not select one silently.

rules.scope: registered aggregate, filter, bin, sort, limit and time-unit expressions
rules.rationale: Transform obligations are part of semantic correctness.
rules.failure_condition: Operation is implicit or outside the registered grammar.
rules.conflict_policy: Conflicting operations remain separate transforms and raise ambiguity.

rules.scope: resolved field candidates with explicit or structural roles
rules.rationale: Measures, groups, time and filters must remain distinct.
rules.failure_condition: Field role evidence is absent or conflicting.
rules.conflict_policy: Retain multiple roles when evidence is tied; never overwrite an upstream candidate.

rules.scope: explicit filter values, negation, time scopes and numeric top/bottom limits
rules.rationale: Filter polarity, temporal scope and limits cannot be reconstructed after they are dropped.
rules.failure_condition: Attachment between expression and field is unresolved.
rules.conflict_policy: Record unresolved attachment or alternatives instead of guessing.

rules.scope: multi-field VisualizationIntentIR roles
rules.rationale: Roles are arrays and relations, not scalar x/y/color slots.
rules.failure_condition: Field evidence is missing or below threshold.
rules.conflict_policy: Preserve all supported roles and explicit role ambiguity.

rules.scope: deterministic IR candidate ordering and identity
rules.rationale: Equivalent evidence must serialize identically and variable candidates must not be cloned.
rules.failure_condition: Input order is nondeterministic or duplicate candidates are present.
rules.conflict_policy: Sort by score, rank and stable names; deduplicate only exact semantic duplicates.
